newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS signs $120 mln term-loan facility.
newsitem.headline: MAS signs $120 mln term-loan facility.

text.p: National carrier Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) said on Tuesday it had signed a $120 million term-loan facility with a group of financial institutions.
In a statement, MAS said the facility was successfully syndicated with oversubscription from its original amount of $102 million.
The facility was arranged by French bank Credit Lyonnais, the Labuan island branches of the Industrial Bank of Japan, and Development Bank of Singapore Ltd.
Of nine lender banks, eight are based in Labuan, Malaysia's international offshore financial centre off Borneo island.
